name: Dream I Club -Dream Image Club-
original_name: DREAM I CLUB-ドリームイメージクラブ-
source:
Welcome to Dream Club, where we’re waiting for pure-hearted folks like you!
We’ve got tons of heartwarming services designed to pamper your body and soul.  

But have you heard about our [ESS (Extra Service System)]?  
You earn [ESS Points] just by spending time with our host girls, which you can cash in for “special services”—our little gem!  
Our handpicked host girls offer a diverse range of fun situations.  
From oral action, 69, foot jobs, tit jobs to doggy style… there’s plenty more to choose from!  

So let’s dive into a fantastic experience—   
Welcome to [DREAM I CLUB]!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120117075349/http://www.studiooguma.sakura.ne.jp/product/sto000/index.html]the official website[/url]]
